name: Bright Smile Dental
about: A friendly family dental practice. New patients welcome, check-ups, hygiene, fillings, crowns and whitening under one roof. Emergency slots every weekday morning.

faq.a: Yes, we accept Bupa, Cigna and Aviva. We do not accept Denplan. Bring your policy number to the first visit.

faq.q: I have severe pain or swelling
faq.a: Please call us on +44 20 7946 0000. Emergency slots are held every weekday at 09:00. If you have swelling that affects breathing or swallowing, call 999.

faq.q: How much is the first visit?
faq.a: A check-up with a hygiene cleaning is 60 GBP for new patients and takes about an hour.
Monday to Friday 09:00-18:00, Saturday 10:00-14:00. Closed on Sunday.
Yes, free parking is available behind the building.
